welcome.title: Welcome to Kaitech
welcome.body: Sign in with your Kaitech account to continue.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.body: Enter your server address. You'll sign in on your server's own page, so this app never sees your password.
signIn.databaseHint: Leave this empty if your server has only one database.
signIn.continueHint: Opens your server's sign-in page in the browser

errors.serverInvalid: That doesn't look like a server address.
errors.serverInsecure: The server must use a secure connection (https).
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and the address, then try again.
errors.accessDenied: Sign-in on this device was declined.
errors.stateMismatch: The sign-in response didn't match this request. Please try again.
errors.codeExpired: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Please sign in again.
errors.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.server: The server ran into a problem. Please try again later.
errors.unsupported: This server doesn't support the Kaitech app yet.
errors.linkNotConfigured: This build can't finish signing in because its sign-in link domain isn't set up.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.accountNotTeam: This account can't use the Kaitech app.
errors.accountInactive: This account is no longer active.

wizard.languageBody: You can change this any time in Settings.
wizard.lockBody: Ask for {{method}} when you come back to Kaitech after 5 minutes away.

lock.title: Kaitech is locked
lock.failed: Couldn't confirm it's you. Please try again.
lock.unavailable: Set up a screen lock on this device first.

tabs.comingBody: This part of the app is still being built.

settings.title: Settings
settings.signOutBody: This device is removed from your account and stops getting its notifications.
settings.signOutOffline: You're signed out here. This device may stay listed in your account until you remove it on the web.

expired.title: Your session has ended
expired.body: Sign in again to keep using {{server}}.
